laziest_solution_that_works.assessment: Used existing Retrofit/URLSession infrastructure created in M6; avoided premature Redux/MVI or state machine frameworks.
laziest_solution_that_works.evidence: Simple sealed interface UiState (Loading, Success, Error) directly inside Compose / SwiftUI views.

zero_unnecessary_abstractions.assessment: Used direct domain models mapped from existing DTOs with lightweight functional extension methods.
zero_unnecessary_abstractions.evidence: No complex repository layers or generic use-case classes invented for single-screen queries.

honest_deferrals.assessment: Persistence deferred to M14. Map SDK deferred to M11. Save buttons hidden rather than faked.
honest_deferrals.evidence: Clean adherence to YAGNI and anti-vibe-code rules.
